# U89: Out and back in: the workbook loaded straight back reads “Nothing would change”; with Status edited on two rows it says those cells differ and Faro never reads them; a column nothing reads is named in the file line; a file exported from another workspace asks before anything else, and its rows can be added as new goals

- **Belongs to:** the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `IMPORT-PREVIEW`, `ROUND-TRIP`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `parity`, `entry`, `logged`, `errors` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/data/import` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 7758

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/data/import` in the demo.
- Choose a file to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field.
- **Check:** “Nothing would change” is shown (else: the workbook loaded straight back would change something).
- **Check:** (`finish`) the words “differs from what Faro works out today” is not there (else: an unedited workbook says worked-out cells differ).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “nothing would change”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Status edited on two rows, and a column of the person's own.
- A downloaded workbook as sheets of rows (`readWorkbook`).
- Choose a file to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field.
- **Check:** “On 2 rows, Status differs from what Faro works out today” is shown (else: the edited worked-out cells are not said).
- **Check:** “the column Budget on Goals” is shown (else: a column nothing reads is not named).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “worked-out cells”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Another workspace's file: asked first.
- _Note:_ Its Start here, and two of its goals.
- Choose a file to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field.
- **Check:** “This file was exported from “Another Org”” is shown (else: a file from another workspace is not asked about).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “Must fix” heading is not there and the “What will be saved” heading is not there (else: the preview went on before the workspace question).
- **Step.** Press the “Add its rows as new goals” button.
- **Check:** “What will be saved” is shown (else: answering the question does not go on to the preview).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
